Soft pieces

Soft vegetable flatbread

Mini zöldséges pizza

12 months+ Replaced 75 min 4 portions

Cut into squares and serve warm as soft pieces. The base should bend, not shatter.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 150 g plain wheat flour (for the dough)
  • 2 g instant yeast (about 1/2 tsp)
  • 95 ml water (lukewarm)
  • 2 tsp olive oil (1 tsp in the dough and 1 tsp on the vegetables)
  • 150 g ripe tomato (simmered to a thick sauce with no salt)
  • 50 g zucchini (diced small and roasted until soft)
  • 40 g sweet pepper (diced small and roasted until soft)
  • 40 g onion (diced small and roasted until soft)
  • 20 g mozzarella (pasteurized, torn small)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Mix the flour, yeast, water, and 1 tsp of oil into a soft dough, and add no sugar and no salt.
  2. Knead briefly, cover the dough, and leave it until puffy, about 45 minutes.
  3. Roast the zucchini, sweet pepper, and onion until soft while the dough rises, and simmer the tomato into a thick sauce.
  4. Press the dough into a small tray so it stays thin, then spread on the tomato, vegetables, and mozzarella.
  5. Bake at 200 C until the base is cooked but still soft and the cheese has melted, about 12 minutes, and do not add ham.
  6. Cool and cut into squares.

Replaced

The usual mini pizza used ham, cane sugar, and salt, and it was aimed at 9 or 10 months. Ham is a salty cured meat, and at that age the bread is too chewy.

Ham and sugar were the problem, and the bread texture is why it waits until 12 months. Bake a soft yeast flatbread with no sugar and no salt, top it with tomato, roasted vegetables, and a little mozzarella, and cut it into squares.
